answer: Cedar outlasts pine because it grew slowly, and seats should have to age the same way. Each seat must hold its own named Counterparty asset, registered on Bitcoin by burning 0.5 XCP, at least 26 weeks old, with the seat's address in the asset description. One asset backs one seat, and names are first-come, so they can't be shared. A ring of 1,000 clones would burn 500 XCP and wait half a year before the first payout (figures assumed). Age is the signal: green timber earns nothing.
